note: TVA campground on the upstream south side of Cherokee Dam, run by the concessionaire Go Camp Tennessee (Vista Recreation), beside a large public boat ramp and a swim beach; 5 of the sites are primitive. Water pressure runs about 100 psi, so bring a regulator. The perimeter and waterfront sites are the roomiest. --Claude
summary: Re-read on the Campspot park record/map and the Go Camp Tennessee page (Wayback, live site 403s): 44 sites, 2-night minimum (stored), season Mar 15-Nov 14, 21-night max stay, showers/flush toilets/dump; max_rig_ft 30 (from note prose) corrected to Campspot's 45. Lakeview holds: the four Campspot 'Waterfront' RV pads sit 4-5 m above summer pool on a wooded bank. Next season not yet bookable, so fees stay as read 2026-10-13 ($33-35 + $10 surcharge).
flags: GATE FACTS (TVA campground stored private): $33 Non Waterfront / $35 Waterfront base per night plus a $10 Reservation Surcharge per stay (Campspot, read 2026-10-13; May 2027 not bookable yet 2026-11-24). Under $50. Google 4.5 from 519; Campspot 4.6 from 69.

WATERFRONT: lakeview holds (no change). Campspot sells 4 RV 'Waterfront Site' pads (max 40 ft) on the east spur toward the water, but on imagery + 3DEP the nearest pads (~36.15461,-83.51410 at 332.5 m; ~36.15497,-83.51381 at 331.5 m) sit on a wooded bank 4-5 m above TVA's ~327 m summer pool, ~25-40 m back from the summer edge with a steep drop to the bare drawdown shore (321-324 m) - fails the kayak test (pads 1-2 m above). The 3 'Waterfront Tent Site' pads are not RV sites.

SITES: count 44 per the operator; Campspot lists only 24 bookable units (15 Non Waterfront RV incl. 3 accessible, 4 Waterfront RV, 5 tent) - the rest may be walk-in/host-assigned or not loaded on Campspot. max_rig_ft 30 was note-derived; Campspot types say 45 / 40 ft.
